corpus_item: RI-MAG02 §D (cost, tiers, prices), RI-MAG01 §B (classes, frames), RI-MAG03 §A (commission markup)
note: The authored part of every record below is ONLY `effects` + `range` + `class`. focus_base, tier, skill_req, focus_cost, gold_price, commission_price, frames and geometry are all COMPUTED by game/src/sim/magic/cost.js and game/data/magic/cast-classes.json. RI-MAG02 M2 recomputes them and asserts an exact match; running the same code is the point, because the alternative is a second implementation that can silently disagree with the game.

amendment_requested.claim: RI-MAG02's provenance note requests the magic line be pinned at '≈28,000 g across 60 purchasable spells (tier mix 26/18/10/5/1)', and RI-MAG03 M8 asserts that total within ±15%. Those two numbers cannot both be true under RI-MAG02 §D's own price formula.
amendment_requested.arithmetic: At RI-PRG05 §2's published band prices — tier-1 220, tier-2 900, tier-3 3,400 — plus RI-MAG02's own derived tier-4 8,350 and tier-5 22,200, a 26/18/10/5/1 shelf costs 26×220 + 18×900 + 10×3,400 + 5×8,350 + 1×22,200 = 5,720 + 16,200 + 34,000 + 41,750 + 22,200 = 119,870 g. That is 4.3× the 28,000 target and 78% of RI-PRG05's entire 152,900-gold discretionary menu. Bottom-loading every band does not close it: the cheapest legal 26/18/10/5/1 shelf is still over 60,000 g, because one tier-5 spell alone is 17,300 g at the band floor.
amendment_requested.resolution_shipped: Tiers 4 and 5 are NOT purchasable. They are commissioned at a spellwright (RI-MAG03 §A, 1.6× + 150 g) or hand-placed (S12). This is also what Morrowind does — the top spells are not shop stock — and it is the smallest change that reconciles the two numbers. All 60 spells ship; 54 are on a shelf.
amendment_requested.note: Filed rather than silently satisfied. If the owners prefer the 60-purchasable reading, the 28,000 figure must move, not the shelf.

cost_model.tier_rule: tier = max(band(focus_base), max effect.min_tier). RI-MAG02 §D bands by focus_base; RI-MAG02 §F calls levitate 'tier 4 (req Warding 65)' at focus_base 8, which is band 1, so the effect's min_tier is a floor on the band. Both numbers are emitted per spell.

spells.name: Spark-Dart
spells.notes: RI-MAG01 §G exemplar. The tier-1 spell every caster starts with.

spells.name: Marshfire
spells.notes: RI-MAG02 §D's worked "balanced" spell. focus_base must be 25.

spells.name: Wamasu-Arc
spells.notes: Arcs through standing water. RI-MAG04 X7: a lore fact that is also a boss-arena tactic.

spells.name: Root-Theft
spells.notes: xul-hesh. RI-LOR05 §3; every cast increments the counter.

spells.name: Sap-Blade
spells.notes: MB-6: an early-game power spike with no upgrade path.

spells.name: Long Hand
spells.notes: MB-4: theft through geometry, 25 m of reach.

spells.name: Sure Hand
spells.notes: MB-2 / RI-EXP06 B-02: opens a seal you have no business opening.

spells.name: Ask the Dead
spells.notes: X2: a corpse produced by a fight becomes a requires.knowledge key.

spells.name: Hist-Sight
spells.notes: Emits ONE prose journal line. No marker, no arrow — an AR-2 automatic fail if it ever does.

spells.name: Still the Beast
spells.notes: X1 / MB-10: a fight that ends with no corpse.

spells.name: Sap and Salt
spells.notes: Three effects: the shape spellmaking exists to let a player build.

spells.name: The Greater Opening
spells.notes: MB-11: opens a quest door before the journal mentions it exists.

spells.name: Feather
spells.notes: X4: moves the player across RI-CMB01's LIGHT/MEDIUM roll cliff mid-fight.

spells.name: Burden
spells.notes: Moves the enemy's equip-load tier. NEVER its windup, tracking cutoff, hitbox or telegraph.

spells.name: Slowfall
spells.notes: RI-MAG02 §F: the traversal workhorse. focus_base must be 3.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.notes: RI-MAG02 §F: focus_base must be 25 at 60 s. Ascent costs a further 1.5 Focus per metre.

spells.name: The Short Hop
spells.notes: RI-MAG02 §F: focus_base must be 8.

spells.name: The Long Flight
spells.notes: RI-MAG02 §F: focus_base must be 66.

spells.name: Mark
spells.notes: S7 network. Outdoors, above ground, outside the 8 loop-dungeons, boss arenas and locked areas, and only where you have already stood.

spells.name: Recall
spells.notes: Magnitude is COMPUTED at cast time as straight-line distance to the mark in hundreds of metres; the authored 20 is the shelf reference only.

spells.name: Rootkeeper Intervention
spells.notes: Nearest rootkeeper shrine. Never a HEARTH.

spells.name: Chapel Intervention
spells.notes: Nine Divines chapel — Gideon, Stormhold, Blackrose only. Which one you carry is a faction statement.

spells.name: Chameleon
spells.notes: Hard clamp at 80% output. 20 points × 3%/pt = 60%.

spells.name: The Deep Chameleon
spells.notes: 27 pts × 3% = 81% nominal, clamped to 80. The clamp is where Morrowind's worst breakage is closed.

spells.name: Silence
spells.notes: S7 denial shape: silence the speaker and the ritual does not complete.

spells.name: Warm Smudges
spells.notes: Diegetic smudges at real world positions. No icons, no compass, no names.

spells.name: The Grey Fuzz
spells.notes: Buildup on S11's meter at magnitude × 4 per contact. Bosses get a raised threshold, never immunity.

spells.name: Demoralise
spells.notes: X1: ARBITRATION §1's right to disengage, made mechanical.

spells.name: Frenzy
spells.notes: MB-5: an indirect murder weapon, attributed to you if anyone with line of sight saw the cast.

spells.name: The Borrowed Scale
spells.notes: Two effects, two schools' worth of intent: get in, and be quiet while you are in.
